verdict.summary: Round 1's major finding is resolved: push-frontier now derives the saturation count from jq's JSON-array length before rendering PR text, flattens title newlines for matching, and exercises the real split/count path with a multiline-title regression test. The other changed enumeration sites consistently bind the requested limit to the asserted cap and refuse saturated snapshots; their tests cover both saturation and cap-minus-one acceptance through the production call sites. No correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue remains in the supplied diff.
